title: Partially cyclopentadienyl-substituted tetranuclear lanthanide Schiff base complexes

material_class.structural_family: hydroxo-bridged tetranuclear Ln4O8 face-sharing defect dicubane

synthesis.procedure: All experiments under dry N2 using Schlenk techniques. To a THF solution of Cp3Pr (15 mL, 2.0 mmol) was slowly added a THF (15 mL) solution of H2L1·1/2H2O (0.45 g, 2 mmol) at room temperature; the color changed immediately from yellow to pale yellow. The mixture was stirred at room temperature overnight, solvent was removed under reduced pressure to an oily residue, and 15 mL of n-hexane was added. The suspension was heated and filtered; the orange-yellow solid was extracted with THF/n-hexane (3 × 10 mL, 5:1 v/v). Combined extracts were centrifuged, the supernatant concentrated to about 10 mL, and light yellow crystals formed on standing at −20 °C for several weeks.
synthesis.time: overnight stirring; crystals after several weeks
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: solvent removed under reduced pressure; n-hexane added; heated and filtered; extracted with THF/n-hexane 5:1; centrifuged; supernatant concentrated to ~10 mL; light yellow crystals at −20 °C

material_class.structural_family: hydroxo-bridged tetranuclear Ln4O8 face-sharing defect dicubane

synthesis.procedure: Under dry N2 Schlenk conditions, a THF (15 mL) solution of H2L2·1/2H2O (0.85 g, 3.0 mmol) was added dropwise to a THF solution of Cp3Nd (20 mL, 3.0 mmol). The mixture was stirred at room temperature for 28 h; the color changed from deep blue to pale purple-blue and finally pale blue. Solvent was evaporated under vacuum to an oily residue, washed with 15 mL n-hexane to a light blue solid, then washed twice with hot n-hexane (2 × 10 mL). The solid was extracted with THF/n-hexane (3 × 10 mL, 5:1 v/v) at reflux. Extracts were concentrated to about 10 mL; pale blue crystals formed on standing at −10 °C for several days.
synthesis.time: 28 h stirring; crystals after several days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: vacuum evaporation to oil; washed with n-hexane then hot n-hexane; extracted with THF/n-hexane 5:1 at reflux; concentrated to ~10 mL; pale blue crystals at −10 °C
